title: Dishes of the Americas
intro: Which country is each dish from? Origins follow Wikidata, and many foods are shared across borders, so these are single-country origins only.

questions.prompt: Which country is Salisbury steak from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives United States of America as the country of origin of Salisbury steak.

questions.prompt: Which country is red velvet cake from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives United States of America as the country of origin of red velvet cake.

questions.prompt: Which country is refried beans from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Mexico as the country of origin of refried beans.
Wikidata gives Brazil as the country of origin of Tacacá.

questions.prompt: Which country is soup joumou from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Haiti as the country of origin of soup joumou.
Wikidata gives Mexico as the country of origin of enchilada.

questions.prompt: Which country is Lomo saltado from?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Peru as the country of origin of Lomo saltado.
Wikidata gives Bolivia (Plurinational State of) as the country of origin of Cuñapé.
Wikidata gives Haiti as the country of origin of griot.
Wikidata gives Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of) as the country of origin of hallaca.
